description: A family with empty index set has a unique choice function; a family with an empty member has no choice function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.empty_choice_cases.{u, v} {ι : Type u} {α : Type v} (A : ι → Set α) :
  (IsEmpty ι → ∃! c, ∀ (i : ι), c i ∈ A i) ∧ ((∃ i, A i = ∅) → ¬∃ c, ∀ (i : ι), c i ∈ A i)
